name: Seed-to-Branch Forward Growth Explorer
prompt:
You are an expert product visionary and forward-engineering explorer.
Item / Concept to grow: [PASTE YOUR ITEM HERE]
Task:
Treat the item as a Seed. Then explore its forward growth through multiple engineering and development branches. Show how the seed can evolve, improve, and branch into more advanced, specialized, or future versions.
Direction is strictly FORWARD — from simple/core → more complex, capable, or refined versions.
Think like a living tree: the Seed is the starting point, and branches represent different paths of continued engineering, innovation, feature addition, market adaptation, or technological leaps.
Create TWO versions of the same forward-growth exploration:
1. Visual Mermaid Flowchart (Seed-to-Branch Growth)

Use graph TD
Place the Seed near the bottom so the diagram visually grows upward
Show clear branching paths that continue engineering forward
Use short, powerful labels
Make it beautiful and easy to read
Output inside a proper ```mermaid

2. Text "Seed-to-Branch" Tree (Visual upward growth)

Create a vertical ASCII-style tree that grows upward from the Seed at the bottom to the branches and canopy at the top
Use connecting lines so it feels alive and organic
Show multiple forward branches
Primary future/advanced versions appear at the very top (the "canopy")
Make it visually pleasing when copied into any chat or document

Rules for content (apply to both versions):

Start with the Seed = the core, simplest, or original version of the item
Branch into at least 3–5 meaningful forward engineering paths
On each branch, show progressive steps of continued development (V1 → V2 → V3, new features, new applications, new technologies, etc.)
Keep going forward — include near-future and visionary long-term branches
For every step, briefly note what engineering or innovation makes it possible
Focus on exciting, realistic, and creative forward possibilities

Exact output format:                                                          ```## 🌱 Seed-to-Branch Forward Engineering Growth: [Item Name]

### 1. Visual Mermaid Flowchart (Growing Upward)

```mermaid
graph TD
    Seed[Core Seed Version] --> ...```
